jd_text: Fictional posting. Tallgrass needs an online program developer to build technical programs in Moodle, keep courses accessible, and improve the course review process.

answers.question: Which LMS platforms have you used?
How do you handle accessibility?
answers.answer: I led a one-term remediation that brought 120 course pages to our standard.

answers.question: Describe a process you improved.
answers.answer: A shared review checklist cut our average review rounds from 3 to 2 across 40 courses.

priorities.title: Program build in Moodle
priorities.detail: Build and maintain online programs in Moodle.

priorities.title: Accessibility
priorities.detail: Keep every course at the accessibility standard.

priorities.title: Review process
priorities.detail: Make course review faster without losing quality.

coach.concern: No experience with technical-trades programs. Show how the design process transfers rather than claiming subject expertise.

stories.title: Course review checklist
stories.situation: Course reviews bounced between designers and faculty too many times.
stories.action: Created a shared review checklist and trained the team on it.
stories.result: Average review rounds fell from 3 to 2 across 40 courses.

stories.title: Accessibility remediation
stories.situation: Course pages did not meet the institution's accessibility standard.
stories.action: Planned and led a one-term remediation sprint with the design team.
stories.result: 120 course pages brought to standard in one term.

stories.title: Leading a design team
stories.situation: A team of four designers had uneven processes.
stories.action: Set shared standards and weekly reviews.
stories.result: A consistent development process; no outcome lift is confirmed.

stories.title: Prompt library for course outlines
stories.situation: Designers spent their first days on every new course drafting outlines from scratch.
stories.action: Built a shared prompt library for first-draft outlines and required a designer review before anything was used.
stories.result: Designers start from a reviewed draft; no time-savings figure is confirmed.

stories.title: Course-QA assistant prototype
stories.situation: Manual QA missed broken links and missing alt text.
stories.action: Prototyped a checklist assistant to pre-screen courses.
stories.result: Prototype only, not in production. Describe it that way.

coach.first_question: Walk me through how you would take a new technical program from outline to launch in Moodle.
